introHtml: Red dog tags make your team members or pets instantly identifiable. Whether you need luggage tags for a sales conference or ID tags for a company event, the bold red color stands out in a crowd. Our red dog tags are available in materials like durable plastic and genuine leather, with custom imprinting options for your logo or contact info. Choose from styles like the Rio Slip-In ID Luggage Tag or the Majestic Leather Luggage Tag for a professional look that lasts.
